defects: Hypothesis predicate differs: gold requires `Manifold.IsImmersionOfComplement F I J n f`, which is parametrized by an explicit 'complement' type F (the splitting used to define immersions rigorously in the possibly-infinite-dimensional setting); produced uses `Manifold.IsImmersion I J n f`, which has no complement parameter. This is a different (and not verifiably equivalent) hypothesis — it is not shown/assumed that `IsImmersion` unfolds to `∃ F, IsImmersionOfComplement F ...`.

Adds unwarranted typeclass hypotheses `[PseudoMetricSpace H]` and `[PseudoMetricSpace H']` on the model target spaces H, H' that are not present in the gold statement (gold only assumes `[TopologicalSpace H]`/`[TopologicalSpace H']`), strictly narrowing the generality of the theorem.
Adds hypotheses `[IsManifold I n M]` and `[IsManifold J n N]` that are not present as explicit hypotheses in the gold statement's context.

The smoothness index `n` is typed as `ℕ∞` (extended naturals) in the produced statement, whereas gold's `n` ranges over a broader index type that also includes the analytic order (ω), so the produced statement is narrower and excludes the analytic-smoothness case covered by gold.

Model-with-corners arguments `I` and `J` are made explicit in the produced statement versus implicit `{...}` variables in gold (minor binder-style difference, not purely cosmetic given other structural changes).
